notes.title: Henry Halfhead is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,
[/h3][p][/p][h3]Our second game [b]Henry Halfhead[/b] is out now! [b]💜[/b]👃💜[/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve been working on Henry Halfhead since the release of Bamerang and are super excited to share the full story of our wonderful halfhead with you all!
[/p][p]If you already own Bamerang, you can get Henry Halfhead at an additional [b]10% discount[/b] in our Lululu Games Bundle:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57925/Lululu/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917644/23c8e49625b9b7816330e65c6379df7277bb58b8.png"][/img][/p][p]Henry Halfhead is a quirky sandbox adventure game about an odd little character with the ability to become any object within their reach. Discover every object's unique properties and abilities and cleverly combine them to take Henry through their not-so-ordinary everyday life.
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Tnhae9LMfC4"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Here’s what awaits you in the game:[/h3][list][*][p][b]300+[/b] objects to transform into, from loaves of bread to paper planes.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]heartfelt story[/b] about life’s little joys and oddities.[/p][/*][*][p]Play alone or with a friend in the [b]local co-op mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Puzzles, surprises, and plenty of reasons to experiment.[/p][/*][*][p]And of course, a few hidden secrets (have fun trying to find [b]Bing Bong[/b] who is visiting from [b]Peak[/b]).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The soundtrack of Henry Halfhead is made by Lucien Montandon who already did the soundtrack for Bamerang. The [b]soundtrack is available to purchase here on Steam[/b], with all of the revenue going straight to the musician:[/p][p]\[BUNDLE LINK]
[/p][p]A big thank you to everyone who supported us throughout development! Making Henry Halfhead has been a weird, wonderful adventure, and it wouldn’t have been the same without such a kind and curious community along for the ride.
[/p][p][b]Thank you again for being part of this journey.[/b]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917644/2d86c96bdba5ef75d048750a588b39d952062893.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy and don’t forget to be yourselves,
[/p][p]- Aaron, Tim, Leander and Jan[/p][p]Lululu Entertainment[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Announcing: Henry Halfhead!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Meet.. [i]Henry Halfhead[/i][/b][/h2]

[b]Hey there![/b]

Since the release of Bamerang, we have been busy working on a new game. Today, we are finally ready to show it to you: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917644/7dcd82dd57859e0a864e718cb1ac91053cd5cd90.png[/img]

In Henry Halfhead, you play as Henry, a funny little character, merely half a head, but with the peculiar ability to possess and control anything within their reach. Discover every object's unique properties and abilities and cleverly combine them to progress through Henry’s not-so-ordinary everyday life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917644/6d55a66de73d123c3617cbb1d0e44aeda2472df1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917644/29a175555c952ed49ff57433ab79019641dcaa93.gif[/img]

Become a knife to slice your morning-toast, water your beloved plants as a watering can and experience how much fun making your bed as bouncy wobbly pillows can be. A humorous narrator accompanies you on your journey through Henry’s life, as you help them to rediscover their lost playfulness.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 150+ Playable Objects:
[*] Local Co-op
[*] A Wholesome Story
[*] Mini-Games
[*] Customize Henry
[/list]
[b]Wishlist the game here: 👀🍎🌞 [/b] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2058140/Henry_Halfhead/


We're aiming to release the game next year and can't wait to hear your thoughts about it. 
If you want to keep up to date about Henry Halfhead follow us on [b][url=https://twitter.com/LululuGames]Twitter [/url][/b] and join our [b][url= https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy]Discord [/url][/b].

[b]Thank you and have a wonderful weekend![/b]

Team Lululu

notes.title: Bamerang Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
It has been more than 4.5 years since we created the very first prototype of Bamerang and it's a very special moment for us to finally release this first game of ours.

[b]Get ready to smack your friends with boomerangs, when Bamerang launches on April 22nd![/b]

If you haven't already, wishlist Bamerang! That would help us out a lot <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236490/Bamerang/

In the past year, we worked extensively to bring the game on the level of quality you deserve!
We squished the (hopefully) last bugs and ported the game to the Nintendo Switch. Meanwhile, the visuals were improved and juicy special effects were added. Our talented composer and sound designer spiced Bamerang up with a SFX overhaul and created super joyful soundtracks.
Thanks to lovely volunteers and a translation agency, the game will be available in various languages.

Thank you so much for your patience through all this time! We hope you are just as excited as us about Bamerang's release!

Drop by in our [url=https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy]Discord[/url] if you want to chat with us or other players :)

-Lululu Entertainment

notes.title: Bämeräng Autumn Festival Demo!
notes.content:
[b]WOOOP, we're excited that Bämeräng is part of Steam's Autumn Edition of its Game Festival![/b] 

We added some exclusive content to the Autumn Festival Demo: 

[b]Unlocked 4 Player-Mode [/b]
For the very first time, you can fight intense four player battles!

[b]Loads of obstacles[/b]
Hide behind obstacles and discover how they change the dynamic of a match!


[h3]About the Demo[/h3]
Bämeräng is a fast paced boomerang fighting game. Fight for the favor of the goddess in an outlandish, colorful world in this local multiplayer game.

During the Game Festival, you'll have the chance to play the new Demo version with the unlocked 4 Player-Mode and new obstacles, which change the feel of the map drastically. Thanks to Steam Remote Play Together, you can play with your Steam Friends!

Wishlist the full version of the game, which features over 20 different map variations:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236490/Bamerang/


Join our Discord to find people to play with and to give us your feedback:
https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy


Thank you for playing Bämeräng!
- Lululu
